description: Tiered usage pricing: graduated or volume tiers, included quantity, package units, minimum charge — Prices a usage quantity against up to 50 tiers, graduated (each tier prices only its own units) or volume (the tier holding the whole quantity prices all of it), for an agent checking a usage bill or quoting a plan. Order of operations: subtract the included quantity, convert to billing packages (per N units, rounded up, down or not at all), price the tiers, add flat fees, apply the minimum charge

included.description: Free quantity subtracted before packaging and tiers (never below zero).

minimum.description: Minimum charge in major units, applied after the tiers.

packageRounding.description: How a partial package is billed when per > 1. Default up.

per.description: Units per billing package (default 1). Tiers are expressed in packages.

quantity.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

rounding.description: Final rounding to the minor unit. Default half-up. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

flatFee.description: Fee in major units charged with this tier.

unitPrice.description: Price per billing unit in major units; sub-cent precision allowed.

upTo.description: Inclusive upper bound in billing units. Omit on the last tier for unlimited.

name: metered-price
